cohort: The study included 84 women experiencing postpartum haemorrhage after caesarean section, admitted to Binzhou People's Hospital between August 2017 and October 2018.
finding: Uterine compression suture is an effective treatment for postpartum haemorrhage following cesarean section, leading to reduced bleeding, shorter bleeding time, higher hemostasis success, faster postpartum recovery, and a lower frequency of adverse reactions compared to conventional treatment.
